method: My own AST enumeration of each owner blob. The historical identity_material returns a dict literal; the adopted owner assigns material = {...} (44 keys) then returns it. I enumerated only the DIRECT top-level keys.
note_on_first_pass: A naive ast.walk over the function yields 41/47 because it descends into nested dicts; and a parent-based heuristic yields 47 current because the adopted owner binds the nested producer_result_envelope dict via an intermediate variable. I therefore enumerated the direct returned/assigned dict only, which is the correct notion of a DIRECT composed field.
nested_witness_evolution_preserved: The 16-field condition-binding-witness preimage (binding_mode, consumer_binding_fingerprint, pairing_authority_ref, producer_predicate_leaf_projection, ...) evolves nested and feeds consumer_binding_fingerprint; it is NOT a new top-level composed field.
value_derivation_source: Adopted owner dataclass defaults at adopted blob lines 376-381, plus the AT07 law that a single direct composition involves no discovery receipt, no recursive handoff, no joint component.
